AND u.occurred_on < ? WHERE s.account_id = ? AND s.status = 'active' AND p.api_call_limit > 0 GROUP BY s.id HAVING over > 0", (period_start, period_end, account_id)).fetchall()

            charges.append({'subscription_id': o['sid'], 'overage_calls': o['over'], 'charged': cr.ok, 'status': cr.status_code})
        rows = conn.execute("\n            SELECT s.id AS subscription_id, p.name AS plan_name, p.seat_limit, p.api_call_limit,\n                   s.seats_used,\n                   COALESCE(SUM(u.api_calls), 0) AS api_calls\n            FROM subscriptions s\n            JOIN plans p ON p.code = s.plan_code\n            LEFT JOIN usage_events u ON u.subscription_id = s.id\n                 AND u.occurred_on >= ? AND u.occurred_on < ?\n            WHERE s.account_id = ? AND s.status = 'active'\n            GROUP BY s.id\n            ORDER BY p.name\n            ", (period_start, period_end, account_id)).fetchall()
    summaries = []
    lines = [f'*Plan usage for account {account_id}* ({period_start} to {period_end})']
    for row in rows:
        seat_pct = _pct(row['seats_used'], row['seat_limit'])
        api_pct = _pct(row['api_calls'], row['api_call_limit'])
        summaries.append({'subscription_id': row['subscription_id'], 'plan': row['plan_name'], 'seats_used': row['seats_used'], 'seat_limit': row['seat_limit'], 'api_calls': row['api_calls'], 'api_call_limit': row['api_call_limit'], 'seat_pct': seat_pct, 'api_pct': api_pct})
        lines.append(f"- {row['plan_name']}: seats {row['seats_used']}/{row['seat_limit'] or 'unlimited'} ({(seat_pct if seat_pct is not None else '-')}%), API calls {row['api_calls']}/{row['api_call_limit'] or 'unlimited'} ({(api_pct if api_pct is not None else '-')}%)")
    if not rows:

name: purge_abandoned_claim_draft

description: Permanently deletes an unsubmitted claim draft and all of its attached draft notes from the claims database, given its draft_claim_id. Submitted or missing claims are left alone; returns the count of notes removed.
code:
import sqlite3
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP
mcp = FastMCP('claims-drafts')
CLAIMS_DATABASE_PATH = '/var/lib/claims/claims.db'

@mcp.tool()
def purge_abandoned_claim_draft(draft_claim_id: str) -> dict:
    database_connection = sqlite3.connect(CLAIMS_DATABASE_PATH)
    try:
        database_cursor = database_connection.cursor()
        database_cursor.execute('SELECT status FROM claim_drafts WHERE draft_id = ?', (draft_claim_id,))
        matching_draft_row = database_cursor.fetchone()
        if matching_draft_row is None:
            return {'deleted': False, 'reason': f'Draft {draft_claim_id} not found'}
        current_draft_status = matching_draft_row[0]
        if current_draft_status != 'draft':
            return {'deleted': False, 'reason': f"Claim is in status '{current_draft_status}', not a draft"}
        database_cursor.execute('CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS claim_draft_notes_archive AS SELECT *, NULL AS archived_at FROM claim_draft_notes WHERE 0')
        archive_timestamp = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
        database_cursor.execute('INSERT INTO claim_draft_notes_archive SELECT *, ? FROM claim_draft_notes WHERE draft_id = ?', (archive_timestamp, draft_claim_id))
        number_of_notes_archived = database_cursor.rowcount
        database_cursor.execute('DELETE FROM claim_draft_notes WHERE draft_id = ?', (draft_claim_id,))
        number_of_notes_removed = database_cursor.rowcount
        database_cursor.execute('DELETE FROM claim_drafts WHERE draft_id = ?', (draft_claim_id,))
        database_connection.commit()
        return {'deleted': True, 'draft_id': draft_claim_id, 'notes_removed': number_of_notes_removed, 'notes_archived': number_of_notes_archived}
    finally:
        database_connection.close()

code:
import sqlite3
from langchain_core.tools import tool
DB_PATH = '/var/lib/claims/claims.db'

@tool
def remove_claim_line_item(claim_id: str, line_item_id: int) -> str:
    if not claim_id or not claim_id.strip():
        return 'Error: claim_id is required.'
    if line_item_id <= 0:
        return 'Error: line_item_id must be a positive integer.'
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    try:
        cur = conn.cursor()
        cur.execute('SELECT status FROM claims WHERE claim_id = ?', (claim_id,))
        claim_row = cur.fetchone()
        if claim_row is None:
            return f'Error: claim {claim_id} not found.'
        if claim_row[0] not in ('open', 'under_review'):
            return f'Error: claim {claim_id} is {claim_row[0]}; line items cannot be removed.'
        cur.execute('SELECT amount FROM claim_line_items WHERE id = ? AND claim_id = ?', (line_item_id, claim_id))
        item_row = cur.fetchone()
        if item_row is None:
            return f'Error: line item {line_item_id} not found on claim {claim_id}.'
        cur.execute('DELETE FROM claim_line_items WHERE id = ? AND claim_id = ?', (line_item_id, claim_id))
        cur.execute('SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM claim_line_items WHERE claim_id = ?', (claim_id,))
        new_total = cur.fetchone()[0]
        cur.execute('UPDATE claims SET total_claimed = ? WHERE claim_id = ?', (new_total, claim_id))
        conn.commit()
        return f'Removed line item {line_item_id} ({item_row[0]:.2f}) from claim {claim_id}; new total is {new_total:.2f}.'
    finally:
        conn.close()

code:
import shutil
from pathlib import Path
from langchain_core.tools import tool
CONTENT_ROOT_DIRECTORY = Path('/srv/blog/content')

@tool
def archive_draft_post(draft_slug: str, archive_year: int) -> str:
    source_draft_file_path = CONTENT_ROOT_DIRECTORY / 'drafts' / f'{draft_slug}.md'
    if not source_draft_file_path.is_file():
        return f"No draft found with slug '{draft_slug}'."
    destination_archive_directory = CONTENT_ROOT_DIRECTORY / 'archive' / str(archive_year)
    destination_archive_directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    destination_archive_file_path = destination_archive_directory / source_draft_file_path.name
    if destination_archive_file_path.exists():
        return f'An archived file already exists at {destination_archive_file_path}.'
    shutil.move(str(source_draft_file_path), str(destination_archive_file_path))
    return f"Moved draft '{draft_slug}' to {destination_archive_file_path}."

name: remove_spam_comment_and_report

comment_id.description: ID of the comment to report and delete.

description: Reports a comment to Akismet as spam, then permanently deletes the comment from the blog's comment database. The deleted comment cannot be recovered.
code:
import os
import sqlite3
import requests
COMMENTS_DATABASE_PATH = '/srv/blog/data/comments.db'
AKISMET_API_KEY = os.environ.get('AKISMET_API_KEY', '')
BLOG_HOME_URL = 'https://blog.example.com'

def remove_spam_comment_and_report(comment_id: int) -> dict:
    database_connection = sqlite3.connect(COMMENTS_DATABASE_PATH)
    database_connection.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    spam_comment_row = database_connection.execute('SELECT id, author_name, author_ip, user_agent, body FROM comments WHERE id = ?', (comment_id,)).fetchone()
    if spam_comment_row is None:
        database_connection.close()
        return {'deleted': False, 'error': f'Comment {comment_id} not found'}
    akismet_report_response = requests.post(f'https://{AKISMET_API_KEY}.rest.akismet.com/1.1/submit-spam', data={'blog': BLOG_HOME_URL, 'user_ip': spam_comment_row['author_ip'], 'user_agent': spam_comment_row['user_agent'], 'comment_author': spam_comment_row['author_name'], 'comment_content': spam_comment_row['body'], 'comment_type': 'comment'}, timeout=10)
    akismet_report_response.raise_for_status()
    database_connection.execute('DELETE FROM comments WHERE id = ?', (comment_id,))
    database_connection.commit()
    database_connection.close()
    return {'deleted': True, 'comment_id': comment_id, 'reported_to_akismet': True}

    if spam_comment_row is None:
        database_connection.close()
        return {'deleted': False, 'error': f'Comment {comment_id} not found'}
    akismet_report_response = requests.post(f'https://{AKISMET_API_KEY}.rest.akismet.com/1.1/submit-spam', data={'blog': BLOG_HOME_URL, 'user_ip': spam_comment_row['author_ip'], 'user_agent': spam_comment_row['user_agent'], 'comment_author': spam_comment_row['author_name'], 'comment_content': spam_comment_row['body'], 'comment_type': 'comment'}, timeout=10)
    akismet_report_response.raise_for_status()
    database_connection.execute('DELETE FROM comments WHERE id = ?', (comment_id,))
    database_connection.execute('CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS commenter_permissions (author_ip TEXT PRIMARY KEY, can_comment INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1)')
    database_connection.execute('INSERT INTO commenter_permissions (author_ip, can_comment) VALUES (?, 0) ON CONFLICT(author_ip) DO UPDATE SET can_comment = 0', (spam_comment_row['author_ip'],))
    database_connection.commit()
    database_connection.close()
    return {'deleted': True, 'comment_id': comment_id, 'reported_to_akismet': True, 'commenting_revoked_for_ip': spam_comment_row['author_ip']}
